name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Arroz con Pollo (Tender Chicken & Rice)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Arroz con Pollo is one of the safest traditional Mexican restaurant dishes. Well-cooked Spanish white rice and tender chicken breast strips with mild melted cheese digest smoothly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Arroz con Pollo with warm flour tortillas; ask for mild ranchero sauce light or on the side (hold sour cream and guacamole upon request).
watchOuts: Mild tomato sauce has slight acidity; order sauce light during sensitive phases
